lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Hmm... this cul-de-sac seems rather peculiar.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Professor, please. We don't have time for mysteries right now.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: A true gentleman always has time to help those in need, Luke.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: *sigh* Fine. What's so peculiar about it?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Notice how all the houses are identical, yet one has its door wide open.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Maybe they're just... airing it out?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: HELP! Someone! Anyone!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Or maybe not.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Come, Luke! Someone needs our assistance!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They rush to the open door.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Oh, thank goodness! I've locked myself out and my groceries are melting!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Your... groceries are inside?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Yes! I set them down to find my keys, went back to the car, and the door locked behind me!

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Fear not, good citizen. We shall solve this predicament.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: We will?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: You did it! My ice cream is saved!

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: All in a day's work. Remember, Luke: we ALWAYS have time for other people.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Even when we're on our way to face our greatest fear?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Especially then.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I... think I understand.
